method: Fresh isolated Git index-tree archive of all staged text/source/records and every Cycle11/Vermeer canonical media payload. Each restored file compared with exact staged Git bytes and media SHA256. Release graph inspection follows using installed repository validator/runtime; no cache substitution or regeneration.
limits: Bounded byte/record/media restoration, not an independent dependency/font installation, continuous playback, device test or complete repository restore.

releaseGraphInspection.scope: Validator modules/runtime from installed workspace, all release record/media reads from restored tree; no independent runtime installation.
